week34.0: Usana, olugobe ngenxa yokungabi nendawo, ngokuqhelekileyo lugcina imilenze yalo ibambene sisifuba ngoxa luqhubeka luhamba rhoqo.
week34.3: Nangona indawo incinane, iintshukumo zentsana kunye nokutshintsha kwesisu sakho kuhlala kubonakala.
week34.4: Ukuqhubeka sinikela ingqalelo kwimijikelo yesiqhelo yomntwana kusoloko kubalulekile de kuzalwe.

week35.0: Umntwana uya eqhubeka ezalisa, nto leyo eya kumnceda alawule ubushushu bakhe xa ezalwa.
week35.3: Uxinzelelo lwebhinki olunamandla lunokubonakala njengoko usana luye luhlaza ngokuthe ngcembe.
week35.4: Nangona indawo incinane, umntwana ufanele aqhubeke ehamba rhoqo njengakwiveki ezingaphambili.

week36.0: Ngokuqhelekileyo izifo zikhule ngokwaneleyo ukuba zikwazi ukuphefumla ngokuzimeleyo, yaye umntwana uyakwazi ukufunxa nokugaya.
week36.3: Maxa wambi usenokuziva ucinezelekile, kuba isibeleko sithatha indawo eninzi phantsi kwamasele.
week36.4: Ukukhulelwa kuthathwa njengokuhlala ixesha elipheleleyo phakathi kweveki 37 neveki 42.

week37.0: Ngoku uninzi lwabantwana luye lwaba ngamakhanda.
week37.3: Ukuziva uxinzelelo olunyukayo lwebhinki kuyinto eqhelekileyo xa usana luzibandakanya nebhinki.
week37.4: Ukususela kule veki, ixesha lokubeleka libonwa njengelingenammiselo yaye ukuzalwa kunokwenzeka nangaliphi na ixesha.

week38.0: Umphezulu omhle owawusigubungela isikhumba uye wanyamalala, yaye amathumbu aqokelela i-meconium, isithole sokuqala seentsana ezisandul' ukuzalwa.
week38.3: Ukuqhelana neempawu zokubeleka kunokukunceda njengoko usondela ekuzalweni.
week38.4: Xa kucatshangelwa ukuba uza kubeleka ngaphandle kwembonakalo yonyango, ngokuqhelekileyo akucetyiswa ukuba kuzalwe ngaphambi kweveki yama-39.

week39.0: Ulusu, olwaluncinci ngaphambili, luye lwaba lukhulu yaye ngoku lukhusela umntwana ngcono.
week39.3: Ukungakwazi ukuzeka kade umsindo nokudinwa okuliqela kuqhelekile njengoko ixesha lokufika kwexesha lisondela.
week39.4: Ukujikeleza kwegazi lomntwana osandul' ukuzalwa kuyaqhubeka kuhlengahlengiswa emva nje kokuzalwa, nto leyo enokunika izandla okanye iinyawo umbala obomvu kancinane okwethutyana.

week40.0: Usana lukhule ngokupheleleyo yaye lukulungele ukuzalwa.
week40.3: Kulindeleke ukuba kubekho iimpawu zokubeleka (ukuqhawula rhoqo, ukuqhekeza kwamanzi) ngeli xesha.
week40.4: Ukuhamba ngaphaya kwexesha elifanelekileyo kusoloko kuyinto eqhelekileyo kwaye akuthethi ukuba kukho ingxaki; ngokuqhelekileyo kunikwa iliso eliqatha.

week41.0: Emva komhla wokuzalwa, ngokuqhelekileyo kunikwa iliso eliqatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba usana luhlala luhle.
week41.1: Ukulinda ixesha elide kusenokuza nokudinwa nokunganyamezeli.
week41.2: Ukugqitha kwexesha lokugqiba kwebanga eliqhelekileyo kukhokelela ekunyuseni kweliso liqela lezonyango.
